homePage.firstParagraphPart1: I build cloud-native software and enterprise AI platforms, transforming complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
homePage.firstParagraphPart2: AWS Certified with multiple certifications, including Developer Associate and Solutions Architect Associate. Specialized in Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern cloud-native architectures.
homePage.coreExpertiseIntro: Designing and building scalable cloud-native software and enterprise AI platforms.

cicd.title: Cost & Automation
items: Reduced infrastructure costs by over $8,000 USD annually by migrating pipelines from CircleCI to GitHub Actions and optimizing resources in AWS ECS.
Consolidated 20+ Lambdas into a single repository with Amplify Gen 2, optimizing resource management and reducing operational complexity.
Automated 50+ CI/CD pipelines for build, test, and deploy workflows with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and CircleCI, cutting manual ops effort and recurring pipeline run costs.

serverless.title: Serverless Architecture
items: Designed and implemented event-driven serverless solutions with Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge, S3, and AppSync.
Implemented infrastructure automation using Terraform, AWS CDK, and Amplify Gen 2 for multi-environment deployments and centralized control.
Developed secure architecture with VPC, subnets, security groups, and identity management with Cognito to ensure isolation and access control.

resilient.title: Refactor & Microservices
items: Refactored 50+ monolithic APIs into scalable microservices following the single responsibility principle, using Go, Node.js, NestJS, Python, and Laravel.
Built full-stack applications with React, Redux Toolkit, and TanStack Query for scalable enterprise web and mobile experiences.
Enabled interoperability between microservices and GCP systems through secure and efficient integrations.

fullstack.title: Cross-Platform Apps
items: Developed ordering and loyalty modules in Next.js, React Native, and React, enhancing user experience in mobile and web apps.
Designed scalable APIs using GraphQL (AppSync) and REST (API Gateway) for critical customer-facing services.
Implemented multi-channel authentication with Cognito, event orchestration with SNS, and access control in distributed environments.

intelligent.title: Technical Direction
items: Led the development of the first multi-authenticator system for digital banking channels, integrating security layers in Cognito, SNS, and VPC.
Designed and coordinated an integration ecosystem between legacy and modern services, enabling a smooth transition to a cloud-native architecture.
Guided technical teams in designing, planning, and deploying scalable, robust solutions aligned with business objectives.

leadership.title: Quality & Culture
items: Implemented CloudWatch dashboards and key metrics for health and performance monitoring across distributed services.
Promoted continuous quality culture and technical ownership at all levels of development and infrastructure.
Validated KPIs and led Scrum delivery while coordinating stakeholders across banking and enterprise programs.

cicd.title: CI/CD & Infrastructure
items: Replaced legacy CircleCI with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD (Bricks), using OIDC for temporary AWS roles, parallel lint/test/build/deploy workflows, Jira traceability, and automated Amplify rollbacks.
Provisioned multi-environment infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, and Bricks across EKS, S3, RDS, and IAM for consistent dev-to-prod delivery.
Automated serverless deployments for healthcare assessment platforms with AWS CDK and EventBridge-driven pipelines; expanded Pytest coverage across 20+ repositories.

observability.title: Observability & Reliability
items: Implemented Splunk trace-based logging and Datadog APM on enterprise AI platforms, plus CloudWatch dashboards, SNS alerts, and Slack incident channels for quick-service retail systems.
Delivered branch and environment-based deployments with automated rollback across isolated dev/qa/prod stacks under a single AWS organization.
Centralized log aggregation and key service metrics for health monitoring, enabling faster incident response and operational ownership.

cloud.title: Cloud & Serverless
items: Designed event-driven serverless systems with Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, AppSync, and EventBridge—including DynamoDB migration/rollback flows and candidate exam orchestration.
Led Amplify Gen 2 monorepo architecture with independent stacks per domain: AppSync GraphQL gateway, DynamoDB streams, KMS encryption, and granular IAM per environment.
Applied AWS Well-Architected pillars—operational excellence, security, reliability, performance, and cost—across client and enterprise solutions.

platform.title: Platform & Integration
items: Led a cross-channel banking integration ecosystem and migration of 50 monolithic APIs to microservices on API Gateway, EKS, Lambda, Cognito, and private VPC networking.
Designed hybrid enterprise architectures connecting on-premise systems to AWS through Direct Connect, VPC segmentation, and secure API Gateway endpoints.
Built internal consumption platforms with React on CloudFront, private API Gateway, Cognito RBAC, and Glue ETL pipelines for enterprise data workflows.

llm.title: LLM & Agent Engineering
items: Built enterprise AI Gateways with LiteLLM and LangGraph, integrating Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry for vector stores, multi-agent routing, tool calling, and LangSmith observability.
Implemented RAG pipelines with document ingestion, vector retrieval, S3-driven dynamic assistant configuration, and WebSocket-based streaming for real-time chat.
Orchestrated LLM workflows with specialized agent deployments, config sync to S3, and secure multi-tenant access patterns for internal AI assistant platforms.

platform.title: AI Platform Delivery
items: Delivered React and TypeScript admin and chat UIs with TanStack Query, reusable components, and Keycloak or Cognito authentication for assistant lifecycle management.
Developed Node.js/Fastify and Python/FastAPI APIs with Prisma or DynamoDB, supporting multi-tenant organizations, conversation flows, and role-based access control.
Deployed AI stacks to AWS EKS with GitLab CI/CD and Bricks or GitHub Actions, enabling consistent multi-environment releases from development to production.
